# .github/ Community Guidelines

> For project-wide community guidelines, refer to the [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) located in the repository root.

## Respect

- Treat all contributors with respect and professionalism
- Value diverse perspectives and experiences
- Be inclusive and welcoming to newcomers
- Avoid personal attacks or discriminatory language

## Professional Communication

| Practice | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Clear language | Use precise, technical language |
| Constructive feedback | Focus on improvement, not criticism |
| Patience | Allow time for responses and understanding |
| Documentation | Document decisions and rationale |

## Code Review Etiquette

| Practice | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Be specific | Provide clear, actionable feedback |
| Be respectful | Acknowledge good work and improvements |
| Be timely | Review PRs within a reasonable timeframe |
| Be constructive | Suggest improvements, not just problems |

## Collaboration

| Practice | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| Share knowledge | Help others learn and grow |
| Ask questions | Clarify requirements before implementation |
| Follow guidelines | Adhere to project standards and conventions |
| Acknowledge contributions | Credit others for their work |

## Reporting Issues

| Step | Description |
|------|-------------|
| Search first | Check if issue already exists |
| Be specific | Provide clear reproduction steps |
| Include context | Add relevant logs, screenshots, or code |
| Follow templates | Use provided issue templates |

## Enforcement

| Action | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| Warning | First offense, non-severe |
| Temporary ban | Repeated or moderate offenses |
| Permanent ban | Severe or repeated violations |
| Contact | Report violations to project maintainers |
